top_issues: 'they answer in 1d, you in 1d' is clipped at the right edge of the H1 row, hiding the full response-window text

top_issues: 'Enforceable right now $40.00' is the product's core promise but appears only three taps deep in Manage→Sovereignty, never on Home

Frame #153 'signed just now' and the co-signed counts are strong evidence but offer no drill-down to the actual signatures

overall.verdict: A genuinely premium, internally consistent dark UI whose biggest liability is that its most important idea — the green 'yours no matter what' vs violet 'hub promise' risk model — is explained only on the Sovereignty page while every other screen assumes the user already knows it. The craft is strong enough to ship to power users, but a first-timer, a treasurer, and a hub operator each hit a wall of undefined jargon (Hub promise, lanes, Depository may pull, at risk, in flight, Lazy board) that the screens themselves never resolve.
priority_fixes: Promote the enforceable-vs-promise split to Home as a one-line risk cue and a 'how to read the colors' link, so the green/violet language is learned before it's relied on (helps Maya, Dmitri, Sofia, Kenji)

Add tap-to-define tooltips or inline glosses for every coined term — 'Hub promise', 'at risk', 'in flight', 'Depository may pull', 'lanes', 'Prepare incoming account', 'Lazy board' — and rewrite the worst offenders ('Yours whatever a hub does', 'Accept it as credit instead') (helps Maya, Tomasz, Fatima, Ravi)

Make high-stakes actions safe and legible: confirmation on 'Forget vault' and 'Reveal recovery phrase', risk framing on 'Accept it as credit instead', and a challenge-window preview on 'Dispute' (helps Kenji, Lena, Marcus)
Fix mobile ergonomics on the money paths: sticky Pay CTA, non-clipped filter chips and response-window text, and a search field on Activity (helps Lena, Ravi, Anya)

Add the operator/treasurer surfaces that are missing on mobile: a counterparty risk overview (Desk-lite), a batch-review screen with counts, and a multi-signer/threshold control on Ownership (helps Marcus, Ravi)
